annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 1797/2024 — Estabelece normas gerais para o desenvolvimento, implementação e uso responsável de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1797/2024 — Establishes general rules for the responsible development, implementation and use of Artificial Intelligence systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Dr. Allan Garcês, PP-MA)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill (PL 1797/2024) setting general rules for responsible AI to protect human rights. It bans discriminatory uses, biometric categorisation and manipulative AI, imposes strict liability on providers and operators, grants a right to contest decisions, gives ANPD regulatory and risk-classification powers, and creates a National AI Council.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits AI use for discrimination, biometric categorisation inferring sensitive traits, untargeted facial scraping, and subliminal/manipulative techniques
Strict liability of AI providers/operators for material or moral damage regardless of system autonomy
Right to contest and request review of significant AI decisions and to correct data
Amends LGPD to empower ANPD to regulate, sanction and classify AI system risks
Creates interministerial National Council on AI (CNIA) with civil society participation; mandatory labelling of AI-generated content
